user.title: Greek electricity prices
user.description: Day-ahead prices for Greece from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Request a free API token at transparency.entsoe.eu (My Account Settings → Web API Security Token), then choose your supplier's dynamic product.

data_description.profile: Pre-fills the supplier's published pricing. Choose “Other / manual” to enter it yourself.

reauth_confirm.title: Greek electricity prices
reauth_confirm.description: The ENTSO-E token was rejected. Enter a new one.

tariff.title: Tariff

data_description.wholesale_multiplier: Multiplier applied to the day-ahead price ΤΕΑ (usually 1.19–1.2, the low-voltage loss factor). Use 1 if your contract has none.
data_description.supplier_margin: Fixed €/kWh the supplier adds: supply price = B × ΤΕΑ + A.
data_description.other_charges: Regulated per-kWh charges (network, ΥΚΩ, ΕΤΜΕΑΡ, ΕΦΚ, ...) from your bill.
data_description.vat: VAT percentage (6% for electricity in Greece).
data_description.cheap_hours: How many hours count as cheap, and the length of the cheapest contiguous window.
data_description.hourly_prices: Greek dynamic contracts are priced on the hourly average of the 15-minute market prices. Turn off to use 15-minute prices.
